what_it_does: BioR5 is an artificial intelligence architecture designed for reasoning about complex biological problems that require different thinking approaches. It combines large language models (statistical pattern matchers trained on text), specialized foundation models (trained on biological images and multimodal data), and links to external biological databases and computational tools. The system intelligently selects which reasoning mode to apply based on the specific biological question.
method_in_detail: The system organizes into three computational layers. Layer A provides parametric memory through large language models. Layer B includes specialized foundation models tuned for multimodal biological data. Layer C connects to external resources including biological databases and domain-specific computational tools. An intelligent selector uses both keyword matching and language model analysis to determine which of eleven distinct biological reasoning modes best suits the current problem.
